descByPlatform.chatgpt: Medium Shot Luxury Product Photograph for AVIATOR 72 gold-aluminum sunglasses travel editorial. Subject: gold-aluminum aviator frames #C9A96A with 'AVIATOR 72' 4pt serif engraved on bridge, gradient brown lenses #5E3A20 top to #8B5A2B bottom, temples folded 28° at right arm, on deep-olive Suede Tray #3E4A2E 24×18cm soft nap, gold chain coiled 25° at 8 o'clock 3 loops, burgundy Full-Grain leather travel journal #5A1D20 top-right closed with elastic loop. Composition: Rule of Thirds frame bridge at 50% x 42% y, Centered hero vertical, Bird's Eye 78° overhead, glasses 52% of frame. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, Schneider 120mm LS Macro at f/11, 1/125s, ISO 50, tripod, focus-stacked 6 frames. Lighting: Softbox Studio Side Lighting + Rim Lighting — 4×6ft softbox camera-left 45° elevation 1.4m (key), 1×3ft strip rim camera-right 30° grazing bridge at 1.0m (rim), 4×4ft white bounce camera-front 0.7m (lens fill), 4×4ft black flag overhead to deepen suede. Material physics: gold anodized specular, gradient lens tint absorption, suede directional nap scatter, burgundy leather grain, chain link micro-facet. Color grade: Capture One Warm-14 LUT grain 7 +0.1 EV. Palette: gold aluminum 32%, deep olive suede 30%, gradient brown 20%, burgundy leather 12%, chain highlight 6%. References: Peter Lippmann Hermès, Condé Nast Traveler, Mr Porter editorial. Exclude: fingerprints, flat lighting, plastic reflection, dust motes, colour cast.
